purpose: External study and structure holdout for the existing biochemical mTOR surrogate; no senolysis or rejuvenation inference.

eligibility.exclude_documents: all document IDs in original raw cache
eligibility.exclude_structures: connectivity block (first 14 characters) of every original frozen dataset InChIKey
eligibility.exclude_molecules: original molecule and parent molecule IDs
eligibility.aggregation: median pChEMBL within molecule connectivity and assay; preserve document and assay units; no averaging between assays
eligibility.assay_description_check: exclude explicit FKBP12-only or cell proliferation/viability descriptions; record exclusions

evaluation.training: original training split only; original validation split supplies existing feature helper but is not used for selection
metrics: average precision when both classes present
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 document-cluster bootstrap resamples of pooled Brier difference vs prevalence; fixed seed 20261004; no CI if fewer than 2 documents
evaluation.subsets: all eligible rows plus each source document; no model, source, threshold or similarity gate selection after results
evaluation.empty_eligible_set: report unavailable external validation, no relaxed gates

limitations: Same database, external source documents and structures only; not independent database curation.
Assay formats, ATP concentrations and enzyme preparations differ.
Original training labels were not qualified to the new stricter assay contract.
No clinical, lifespan, senolytic selectivity or tissue regeneration endpoint.
